data.gender_notes: Lutfah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'l-t-f', meaning 'to be soft, gentle, or kind'. In Islamic culture, Lutfah represents the divine attribute of mercy and compassion. The name Lutfah carries the meaning “Grace, kindness, tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lutfah usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, kindness, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lutfah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
